captions.detailed: A realistic 3D model of a space satellite. It features a central rectangular prism body in gold and black, with a grey top cap housing a small antenna and a dark grey propulsion nozzle at the bottom. Two large rectangular solar panels are attached to the left and right sides via small support bars; one panel shows a dark blue grid pattern representing solar cells while the other is a plain grey backing. A circular parabolic dish antenna is mounted on the front face of the body via a multi-jointed arm.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a satellite using CadQuery. The design should feature a central rectangular gold-and-black chassis, a grey top cover with a small omnidirectional antenna, a bottom thruster nozzle, two large solar panels extending symmetrically from the sides, and a steerable parabolic dish antenna on the front face.
captions.factory: Construct the satellite body using a Box primitive for the main chassis, colored gold, with black panels inset on the sides. Create the top cap with a grey Box and a small cylinder/sphere combination for the top antenna. Use a cone or tapered cylinder for the bottom thruster nozzle. Model the solar panels as thin Boxes with support arms, applying a dark blue grid texture to represent solar cells on one side. Build the front parabolic dish using a thin spherical shell (Sphere with boolean subtraction or shell transform) mounted on a cylindrical support arm.
